series.ja: アーク・フォージ：イグニッション

title.ja: ゼロ・カタリスト・ドロップ

status: cold open written; acts A/B outlined
notes: Every dialogue line carries both languages. Timing per cut is set by the LONGER of the two dubs.
No lip-sync: speaking characters are framed from behind, off-screen, in silhouette, or as an eyes/hands close-up.
One named character per shot (traits swap when two named characters share a close shot).
keyframe_prompt: Animagine tag style; the named characters' tags from bible.md are prepended automatically.
motion_prompt: plain English for Wan 2.2: describe what moves and how the camera moves.
ja_review: a native speaker must check these lines before the Japanese dub is published.

motion: 'wan' = animated with Wan 2.2 (slow: minutes per clip); 'still' = keyframe + pipeline camera; 'clip' = pre-rendered frames (e.g. the Remotion title card, path relative to this file). 'fx' (any motion type) = pipeline effects such as ken_burns or speed_lines.

voices_ja: VOICEVOX characters by name (provisional casting). List installed voices with `python scripts/voicevox_client.py`; audition with `--say "テキスト" --speaker 名前 --style スタイル`. ja_style on a line picks that character's emotion style (unknown -> default style + warning). The JA dub shows EN subtitles.

anime_timing (production.assembly default, per-cut fx override): hold each Wan frame 2 ('on twos') or 3 ('on threes') frames for a drawn-anime cadence; camera moves stay smooth. fx.impact: inverted B&W frame + white flash + settling shake at the given seconds.

Audio: cut 'sfx' cues and segment 'audio.music' cues reference names registered in assets/audio/manifest.json (scripts/audio_manifest.py, scripts/fetch_sfx.py). Unregistered names are skipped with a warning so renders keep working while sounds are collected.

segments.sound_design_note: Drone under c001-c006, hard stop into the c007 impact, SILENCE under c008 so Gōda's last line lands alone (sound drop), title sting on c009.

beats: Morning of the ranking exam. Kaito's run to the academy (comedy: late, catalyst gate refuses to open for a Zero).
Catalyst reading ceremony: every scanner reads 0. Laughter. Gōda doesn't laugh.
Rei Shinonome's S-rank demonstration: flawless cyan constructs. Her eyes catch Kaito once.
Hazard-simulation exam briefing: teams must stabilize simulated Wildfire Veins.
Kaito teamed with no one ('Zeroes don't get teams'). He enters anyway.
Simulation glitch: the training vein turns real. Readings spike, alarms. (Plant: a technician quietly removes a device.)
Students trapped behind fire. Rei shields them but her construct is cracking.
Kaito runs IN while everyone runs out (impact frames, speed lines).
He grabs the vein bare-handed. Gray frost-cracks climb his arm. The vein goes dark.
Every catalyst within ten meters flickers off, including Rei's. Silence.
Security drones surround him. 'Unregistered catalyst anomaly.' He's taken down.
Back in the interrogation room. Gōda believes him and isn't allowed to say so.
The Director on a monitor (face unseen): 'Find out what he is. Quietly.'
Kaito alone, flexing his numb hand. The frost-cracks haven't fully faded.
Slums under the towers. A hooded figure holds a vial of glowing Vein crystal: 'So the zero finally woke up.'
